results.description:
Today’s older adults are more active & independent than ever. Unfortunately, falls & motor vehicle crashes continue to disrupt the best years of their lives. 

FallCall Solutions has radically changed safety tech through non-stigmatizing, affordable innovation.

Welcome to the world's most comprehensive safety app: FallCall Detect!

24/7 Emergency Monitoring
US call center with trained emergency medical dispatchers providing customer service & emergency help.

Smart Fall Detection
Not every fall needs medical help. Backed by research, FallCall's "Smart" fall detection for Apple Watch can differentiate fall severity. Detected high-impact, standing falls will notify FallCall’s 24/7 monitoring services & caregivers while sending emergency services if needed.* Detected low-impact, sitting falls will notify a user’s caregroup only.**

4G LTE Cellular Medical Alert
With fall detection & two-way voice built in, notify emergency dispatchers & caregivers when help is needed. Available at FallCall.com.

Pair with Kwikset® Halo locks
Reduce emergency entry delays & eliminate the fear of EMS "breaking down the door." FallCall will unlock your Kwikset lock with ambulance dispatch.

Apple® Crash Detection (iPhone 14 & later)
First app in the world to integrate Apple Crash Detection into a 24/7 monitoring center.**

Connected Pendant Compatible
Add a Trelawear jewelry pendant(Trelawear.com) or FallCall Pendant with fall detection(FallCall.com) to remotely activate app within 100+ feet.*

FallCall Wristband
Discreet safety on your wrist. Change bands to match your style.

Other Features:
•16+ hours of fall detection on latest Apple Watch(results may vary)
•Adjust fall sensitivity
•Siri® activated Help Calls
•Elders may pair 5 caregivers
•Caregivers may pair 2 Elders
•Integrates with Health App
•Elder location & heart rate relayed to Caregivers during Help Calls***
•Elder Apple Watch & cellular medical alert battery levels sent to caregivers
•Works over cellular/Wi-fi/Bluetooth® for equipped Apple Watch & iPhone devices

Subscription 24/7 Monitoring Service:
•Staffed by trained Emergency Medical Dispatchers
•When a Help Call is triggered, our dispatchers will call you and/or your caregroup
•Real-time text updates sent to caregroup members during an event
•PSAP(Public Service Answering Point) technology
•Monthly subscription half the cost of most medical alerts ($17.99/mo)

Connected Pendant/Wristband subscriptions: 
1) Caregroup ONLY Help Calls ($9.99/mo) 
2) Caregroup + 24/7 Monitor Help Calls ($19.99/mo)

Subscription details:
Your Subscription Service starts when it is activated through the FallCall Detect App. Service will remain in effect for a minimum of one (1) month from the date of activation after which it may be terminated by either you or FallCall Solutions for any reason. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime with your App Store account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.
For more information, See "Terms of Service" for details: https://www.fallcall.com/Docs/FallCallDetect-Terms-and-Conditions

*Subscription required. 

**Fall detection will not detect all falls and will not always accurately differentiate between high vs. low impact falls. Crash detection does not detect all crashes 

***As with all location-based services, it may not always be possible to determine your location. Multi-level buildings, parking garages, & even dense urban areas can make it difficult for satellites & cell phone towers to locate your exact location. 

FallCall Detect is not a replacement for 9-1-1. If 9-1-1 is necessary, FallCall Solutions recommends calling 9-1-1 directly.

results.description:
FallGuard keeps your family safe by detecting falls and streaming live vitals from your loved one's Apple Watch to your phone — instantly.

ALERTS THAT GET THROUGH
A fall alert can reach you even when your phone is silenced or in Do Not Disturb. Most apps go quiet at night — the one time a fall is most likely to go unnoticed. FallGuard doesn't. You'll be asked once whether to allow this, and you can turn it off anytime.

LIVE VITALS, ON YOUR DASHBOARD
See heart rate, breathing, and blood oxygen as the watch reads them. Open the app and the latest readings are waiting for you.

CUSTOM ALERT LEVELS
Set the limits that matter for the person you're watching over. Heart rate above 100? Below 50? Oxygen below 92%? Their watch fires an alert the moment any value crosses your threshold — no waiting hours for the next summary.

FALL DETECTION
When the wearer's Apple Watch detects a fall, FallGuard immediately sends an urgent push notification with the time and GPS location to all caregivers. No checking email, no delays — an instant alert right on your iPhone.

ONE PERSON, ONE CARD
The redesigned dashboard shows a big card for each person you're watching over — their name, status, and last update at a glance. Tap a card for full details.

SIMPLE SETUP
Pick whether you're wearing the watch or someone else is, and the app shows you the right experience. Add a person with their family code and you're done — no jargon, no menus to dig through.

WHO IT'S FOR
Adult children watching over aging parents. Caregivers monitoring patients. Anyone who wants real-time visibility into a family member's health and safety, without waking up at night wondering if they're okay.

PRIVACY
Vitals data only flows to caregivers who joined with your family code. Apple Watch handles fall detection and emergency calling at the OS level — FallGuard never replaces that, only supplements it with family-side awareness.

REQUIREMENTS
• An Apple Watch with watchOS 10 or later for the wearer
• An iPhone running iOS 17 or later for caregivers
• HealthKit and Notifications permissions

We'd love your feedback. Reach us at support@fallguard.me.

A FULL DAY OF HEALTH, NOT JUST A MOMENT
FallGuard records vitals throughout the day and keeps a history, so you can see trends over time — not just a single stale reading. Compare this week to last to catch changes early.

KNOW THE WATCH IS WORKING
See at a glance whether the watch is worn, off, or charging, plus its battery and your loved one's phone battery — so you always know whether "no update" means all is well or the watch just needs putting on.

Snug is a simple daily check-in app for people who live alone. Once a day, at a time you pick, you tap a button to say you're okay. If you miss it, Snug alerts the people you trust.

Made for:
- Older adults living alone who want to keep their independence
- Adult children checking on a parent without calling every day
- Pet owners who want someone to know if something happens
- Anyone aging solo, without family nearby

How it works:
- Pick your daily check-in time
- Tap once to check in
- Miss it, and Snug alerts your emergency contacts by text
- Add as many contacts as you like, free

Want more? The Dispatch Plan adds a live call from Snug's team if you miss a check-in, plus a wellness check.

A modern alternative to a medical alert pendant. No wearable, no equipment, just your phone. Trusted for over 20 million check-ins and featured by AARP.

Lively Link™, a free app for your smartphone, keeps you informed about the health and safety of loved ones who subscribe to a Lively Health and Safety plan.

Link can provide peace of mind by sharing timely updates about your loved one. You can check in with them when you want, from anywhere, without disturbing them – helping them maintain the independent life they love.

Exclusive features help them stay independent and you feel reassured.

Once you accept the invite from your loved one and successfully set up Link, you’re able to access the following features:

Receive Emergency Alerts

Link will send you notifications for selected actions including when your loved one has contacted Urgent Response on their Lively device, allowing you to make decisions quickly and follow up without delay. 

Retrieve Location

When the locator permissions are on you will see your loved one’s location on a map and receive updates if they change location. These general updates happen approximately every 20 minutes. 

In an emergency, First Responders get location updates every 30 seconds. 

Check Activities
Based on information in the Lively device user’s Personal Profile, see if appointments are being kept and receive other reports about their activities.

Check Device Status

Get peace of mind knowing your loved one always has access to a professional in the event of an emergency. Link will let you know the Lively device Battery Status. You’ll also be notified when the battery is low so you can remind your loved one to recharge or replace the battery and stay connected. 

Get Articles to Help You Support Your Loved One

Resource center featuring helpful articles, advice and tips for seniors and their loved ones.

Personalization

The Link team cares that the app is tailored to you. That’s why there are settings allowing you to choose which notifications you receive, add a picture of your loved one and even save their phone number – so you can call them directly from the app.

We want you to have a great app experience. If you have any questions about the Link app or simply can’t find your favorite features, email us at customerservice@lively.com we’ll be glad to help.

https://www.lively.com/link

Technical Help

Find answers to common questions in our FAQs. For additional assistance, tap ‘Contact Us’ from Link or call (800) 733-6632.

KamiCare is the most accurate, affordable and easy-to-install fall detection solution for memory care, assisted living and senior living communities. 

Powered by edge-based vision AI and with its near real-time notification capabilities, KamiCare enables senior care community employees to provide immediate care to one of the most vulnerable groups of people when they need it the most. 

The KamiCare mobile app works in conjunction with the KamiCare sensor and the KamiCare web application to keep elders safe. As soon as the KamiCare sensor detects a fall, caregivers and administrators are informed of the incident so that they can provide assistance to the elderly.
 
Using the KamiCare app, a user can:
- Receive real-time push notifications as soon as a fall happens
- Understand whether an incident has been acknowledged or not
- Acknowledge that an incident is being attended to
- View the fall incidents that happened in a community in the last 30 minutes
- View details of each incident along with an image snapshot taken around the time of the fall

For more information, please visit www.kamivision.com/kamicare

Fall Alert-My Medic Watch is a smartwatch app which interprets data captured by sensor technologies on your watch. By using innovative algorithms, it automatically detects if the wearer has a fall and activates immediate emergency assistance.

My Medic Watch provides monthly and yearly subscriptions which include a 30-day free trial. 

We do not sell or provide smartwatches, view our compatible smartwatch options at https://www.mymedicwatch.com/smartwatches/

Today, more and more people are choosing to live independently, in their own homes, aided by vital technology innovations like Fall Alert-My Medic Watch, which was validated by Medical trials in Sydney.

Fall Alert-My Medic Watch is designed to be downloaded to a wearable device such as a smartwatch. It can be worn by people of all ages who are prone to fall, and people who are still living alone in their home.

This ground-breaking app uses proprietary and innovative algorithms, which interprets data automatically captured by sensor technologies on the smartwatch, to determine if the wearer has a Fall.

If the wearer does have a fall, Fall Alert-My Medic Watch automatically detects it and notifies all dedicated caregivers, without the need for manual intervention, providing details of the individual’s location. The app can also be activated manually by the wearer if he or she is feeling unwell and requires assistance, simply by pressing a button on their smartwatch.

Fall Alert-My Medic Watch allows people who are vulnerable to falls to get immediate care and assistance when they have a fall, so they remain feeling safe in their normal environment and can keep their autonomy.

This process has four steps:

1. Smart Detection: As soon as a fall occurs, Fall Alert-My Medic Watch detects it using smartwatch sensors and an accurate algorithm.

2. Immediate Alert: The app then automatically sends notifications with the wearer’s GPS location to the nominated caregivers without the need for manual intervention based on workflows of escalation.

3. Reassurance for Everyone: All caregivers are sent updates of the progress, keeping everyone informed and reassured.

4. Real-Time Data: Included in the user’s subscription is access to real-time data for all related medical episodes. The user can also choose to give access to his or her doctor, so that their medical data can be reviewed securely, online. The App uses HealthKit to save and store the user's heart rate during the medical episode.

Thanks to Fall Alert-My Medic Watch, those with a condition that makes them susceptible to falls, can continue to live independently in their own homes, with ultimate peace of mind.

App subscription information:

With the Fall Alert-My Medic Watch app subscriptions, the wearer has his/her smartwatch app running and benefits from being monitored all the time with automatic fall detection. These app subscriptions include automatic medical event app notifications to the patient and to the caregivers.
